falhas.original: Seventh Sense — Athena Devotees you control get +1/+1. Awaken Ability — Cost: 5 Cosmo. If an Athena Devotee would be destroyed, you may pay 5 Cosmo. If you do, it is not destroyed and its Resistance becomes 1 instead.
